dataset_metadata.name: ARES-MED Unified Simulation Scenario Seeds, Symptom Logs & Real-Signal Replay Manifests
sources: Quantitative Physiological Dataset for Microgravity Spaceflight Simulation (PDF 1)
dataset_metadata.description: Unified scenario library for Dheer's Layer-1 simulator, mapped 1-to-1 to Yohan's RAG CPGs via linked_cpg_id. Scenario labels must remain hidden from the diagnostic agent during evaluation.

state_space_model.equation: x_k(t) = baseline_k(t) + severity * delta_k * g_k(t) + eps_k(t)

onset_recovery_envelope.onset: g_k(t) = 1 - exp(-(t - onset) / tau_up_k)  (onset <= t < recovery)
onset_recovery_envelope.recovery: g_k(t) = g_k(recovery) * exp(-(t - recovery) / tau_down_k)  (t >= recovery)
onset_recovery_envelope.rule: Do not apply automatic recovery to untreated hemorrhage, tension pneumothorax, or ongoing toxic exposure.

correlated_human_variability.equation: eps_t = Phi * eps_(t-1) + L * z_t; z_t ~ Normal(0, I); L * L^T = covariance
correlated_human_variability.rule: Preserve HR-RR coupling and realistic autocorrelation; never use independent white noise per channel.

state_space_model.evaluation_blind_rule: Hide scenario_id from Yohan's RAG agent; expose only 1 Hz telemetry, symptom_log, history, and permitted point-of-care diagnostics.

quantitative_crisis_trajectories_and_sym.physics_note: Cerebral blood flow rises ~3.8% per mmHg delta-PaCO2 in eucapnia (35-55 mmHg) and ~3-6% per mmHg during hypercapnia.

tiers.symptom_log: Woke up with a dull frontal pressure headache and mild facial warmth; sleep felt fragmented and eyes feel slightly dry.
Frontal headache is throbbing now with mild nausea, malaise, and strange tingling along my cheek and jaw; breathing feels deeper at rest.
Severe air hunger and chest heaving, pounding headache, dizzy and losing track of checklist steps—switching to emergency scrubber bypass.

quantitative_crisis_trajectories_and_sym.biodosimetry_equation: N(t) = N0 * exp(-k(D)*t); at 3-4 Gy, 50% ALC drop at 48 h -> k = ln(2)/48 h = 0.0144 h^-1 (0.347 day^-1); normal ALC 1.5-3.5 x10^9/L

tiers.symptom_log: Developing mild nausea and zero appetite several hours after shelter egress; feeling unusually weak and drained during light cabin work.
Vomited twice within two hours of the storm peak; persistent headache, skin feels feverish, and my resting pulse is noticeably fast.

tiers.trigger_threshold: >= 6.0 Gy (TE < 1 h, high fever, diarrhea, hypotension/CNS)
tiers.symptom_log: Immediate violent vomiting under an hour post-exposure with watery diarrhea, high fever, and severe dizziness and confusion when moving.

thermal_physics.adiabatic_time_to_cdo_min: 13.1-17.6 min at 350-470 W (78.5 kg mean astronaut mass)

tiers.symptom_log: LCVG feels tepid inside the torso; sweat is pooling on my forehead and my visor is starting to mist during translation.
Heavy sweating inside the suit, heart pounding hard on simple glove grip tasks, and growing fatigue—calling for a thermal cooling pause.

tiers.trigger_threshold: Delta-Q_stored >= +4.7 kJ/kg (CDO ceiling, CBT > 40 C risk)
tiers.symptom_log: Extreme heat exhaustion, dizzy with narrowing vision, and struggling to sequence tether steps—aborting EVA and returning to airlock.

quantitative_crisis_trajectories_and_sym.kinetics_note: R+1 standing HR 99 (+22 bpm); post-flight delta-HR >= 30 bpm; LDSF stand-test SAP -12 mmHg (-12%); presyncope at ~40% SV drop; BRS falls 50% (10 to 5 ms/mmHg).

tiers.symptom_log: Heart is racing noticeably as G-load builds during entry; slight head-lightness when sitting up, but vision stays clear.

tiers.trigger_threshold: delta-HR >= +30 bpm, SAP dropping toward -12 mmHg
tiers.symptom_log: Pounding tachycardia, sudden wave of lightheadedness and clammy sweat, and peripheral vision starting to dim when trying to sit upright.

tiers.trigger_threshold: ~40% SV drop, severe SAP fall, presyncope imminent
tiers.symptom_log: Severe gray-out closing in with intense nausea and ringing ears—remaining flat on my back, unable to stand for nominal egress.
Breathing feels slightly deeper and quicker during routine module work, with subtle lightheadedness.
Distinct air hunger and rapid breathing, throbbing headache, racing pulse, and noticeably sluggish reading digital displays.
Severe confusion and dimming vision, tingling numbness in lips and fingers, gasping for breath and fumbling the emergency O2 valve.

quantitative_crisis_trajectories_and_sym.equation: IOP = F/C + PV (F ~ 2.9 uL/min, PV ~ 9-10 mmHg)

tiers.trigger_threshold: Early hyperopic shift (< 0.50 to >= 0.50 D), Frisen 0-1
tiers.symptom_log: Near-field checklist text looks slightly soft this week; stepping up to stronger reading glasses sharpens it immediately.
Persistent farsighted blur even with updated lenses, faint wavy distortion near the center of my right eye, and dull ache behind the globes.

tiers.trigger_threshold: Frisen >= 2, headache, pulsatile tinnitus, TVOs, CSF > 25 cmH2O
tiers.symptom_log: Constant headache, rhythmic whooshing sound in my ears, and brief seconds-long visual blackouts when turning my head—requesting flight surgeon consult.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Ammonia leak
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Burning eyes/throat, tearing, cough, chest tightness and dyspnea.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Use an exposure-driven branch, not a fixed concentration-to-vitals rule.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Hydrazine / MMH / N2O4 exposure
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Irritation, cough, dyspnea, nausea, headache; hydrazines can cause tremor/seizures.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Keep MMH and oxidizer-specific toxicology separate despite sharing an example stress vector.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Carbon monoxide poisoning
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Headache, dizziness, nausea, weakness, chest pain, confusion.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Conventional SpO2 may be falsely reassuring (0*); add hidden COHb state and mark saturation untrusted.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Combustion / smoke inhalation
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Cough, hoarseness, soot exposure, airway irritation, dyspnea and confusion.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Delayed airway/lung deterioration and CO bias require separate branches; SpO2 alone cannot exclude toxicity.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Tension pneumothorax
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Chest pain, dyspnea, rapidly worsening distress and shock.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Rising intrathoracic pressure impairs venous return; use staged BP deterioration and NO automatic recovery.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Corneal abrasion / regolith in eye
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Foreign-body sensation, tearing, photophobia, pain and difficulty opening eye.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Systemic vitals remain almost normal; symptom_log and PanOptic fluorescein carry the signal.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Severe burn
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Pain, erythema/blistering or deep injury, swelling; later fluid loss and thermal imbalance.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Include burn extent/depth and inhalation injury as distinct states.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Laceration / hemorrhage
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Visible blood loss, pallor, thirst, weakness, dizziness and confusion.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: SpO2 may remain normal despite low oxygen content; poor perfusion corrupts pulse signal; NO automatic recovery.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Dental abscess
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Localized tooth pain, swelling, tenderness, fever, painful chewing.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Progressive facial swelling/trismus indicates a higher severity stage.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Ear / sinus barotrauma
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Ear/sinus pain, fullness, hearing changes, vertigo.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Pulmonary barotrauma is a separate hypoxemic/chest-injury branch, not the same seed.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Renal calculi / renal colic
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Severe flank pain radiating toward groin, nausea/vomiting, possible hematuria.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Fever requires infection/obstruction branch.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Atrial fibrillation / arrhythmia
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Palpitations, irregular pulse, weakness, dyspnea or dizziness; can be asymptomatic.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: RMSSD must be null / flagged non-autonomic during Afib or frequent ectopy.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Acute appendicitis
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: RLQ abdominal pain, anorexia, nausea and fever.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Pain localization and peritoneal findings belong in symptom/exam channels.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Urinary retention
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Inability to void, suprapubic discomfort/distention, urgency, agitation.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Do not require hypoxemia or fever in an uncomplicated case.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Sepsis / systemic infection
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Confusion, fever or feeling cold (hypothermic variant -1.0 C), clammy skin, tachycardia and breathlessness.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Include hypothermic variant (-1.0 C); normal temperature does not exclude sepsis.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Anaphylaxis
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Urticaria/flushing, airway swelling, wheeze, GI symptoms and circulatory collapse.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Model airway and vascular components separately.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Severe space motion sickness
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Nausea, vomiting, pallor, sweating, malaise, disorientation.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Subsequent dehydration is a separate cumulative state.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Hypothermia
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Shivering, clumsiness, confusion, then slowing pulse/respiration as severe.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Low perfusion impairs oximetry; RMSSD invalid/null with temperature-altered rhythm.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Acute panic attack
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Fear, chest tightness, dyspnea, tremor, tingling and lightheadedness.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Benign confounder test: hyperventilation need not lower SpO2; avoid diagnosing panic solely from vitals.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Severe sleep deprivation
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Sleepiness, attention lapses, irritability and slowed cognition.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Large acute vital changes are not required; use performance and sleep history.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Dehydration / volume depletion
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Thirst, dry mouth, reduced urine output, weakness and postural lightheadedness.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Severity depends on fluid losses and intake.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Acute bronchospasm
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Wheeze, chest tightness, prolonged expiration, dyspnea.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Measurements can lag symptoms; severe obstruction may produce weak breath sounds.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Pulmonary embolism
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Sudden dyspnea, pleuritic discomfort, tachycardia, possible syncope.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Add VTE/IJV thrombosis risk/context state.

synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.name: Seizure / postictal state
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.symptoms: Altered awareness/convulsion followed by confusion and fatigue.
synthetic_scenario_seeds_24.guardrail: Use ictal/postictal phase machine, transient apnea, and motion artifact; RMSSD null.

physionet_datasets.use: Best immediate 1 Hz replay adapter (clinical cohort, no continuous BP or core temp)

physionet_datasets.use: Healthy stress/exercise variability, motion artifacts, and recovery (never relabel skin TEMP as core temp)

physionet_datasets.native_rates: ECG & 6x PPG 500 Hz, load cells 80 Hz, IMU 500 Hz, spot BP/SpO2
physionet_datasets.use: Movement & ECG-PPG timing (do not infer continuous calibrated BP from PPG/PTT alone)
